violation_type.title: Field Trips - Copy of Food Allergy Plan and Medications needed (26 TAC §746.3001(5))
violation_type.short_title: Field Trips - Copy of Food Allergy Plan and Medications needed
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that two children were on a field trip without their food allergy emergency plans and allergy medications.
